analysis:
Both units are base-side excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 1-797). The only changed lines are on the head side (956-991), a documentation-only addition describing an excluded startup shape warmup (ModelCalibrationPolicy.shapeWarmup). The patch excerpt is truncated and the head text was not supplied, so the exact new text is not visible.

The visible patch does not change code or security controls. It describes warmup that runs greedy 128-token probes and shape cells with the artifact's default sampling. The cells use synthetic prompts and a 20-second wall budget. They train no rates or counters.

Remaining integration questions for a code pass, not findings:
- Warmup prompts must not enter the encrypted SSD prefix cache (T-041). They should be non-donating or use an isolated cacheSalt/scope. Otherwise the warmup could create cache artifacts or alter the TTFT oracle.
- Warmup must not hold or race the KV/shared-budget reservations used by request admission.
- Warmup must not emit coordinator receipts or billing.
- Warmup must not delay App Attest / connection-control handling (TB-011).
- The warmup's compile-time timing is a local-only concern.

The base-side Nemotron Super and GLM text is unchanged context. I found no new attack surface or invalidated threat assumption in the supplied evidence. The actual warmup implementation is outside the supplied evidence, so I request no finding. A reviewer should confirm the points above if the code changes ship in the same PR.
